steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: Heh... That toy factory you are talking about...

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: ...I know that place. All the scavengers around here know... the Buonanotte Factory.

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: It was just an obscure little workshop manufacturing plushies, plastic dolls, and stuff like that.

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: Its business was getting worse by the day, with only a handful of employees hanging on.

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: Then one day, out of the blue, the last few employees were gone overnight too... as if they vanished.

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: From then on, the factory has stayed abandoned.

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: And after a while, it became part of the Rust and home to those man-eating creatures too...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Man-eating creatures?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sounds like it might indeed be related to Mania.

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: Hehehe, want to know the truth about the factory? No one can answer your question.

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: Reporters, exorcists, and intruders who cross the Rust wanting to spend the night in the factory... Too many people have been there.

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: No one who came to the factory at night managed to come out the second day.

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: The more mysterious it is, the more people are curious about it! The more people investigate, the more people go missing!

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: What's really inside that factory? The rumor has too many versions.

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: Some say the toys in the factory have come to life.

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: But more mention metal wheels and a ghost in white...

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: A pale wheelchair-bound girl appearing in various corners of the factory.

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: Without exception, those who lay eyes on her will all...

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: Turn! Into! Toys!

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: With both body and mind trapped in a small toy, never able to escape from this factory again.

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: They can only lie on the factory floor, day after day, until they are forgotten by the world...

steps.speaker: Aged Voice
steps.content: Spending their last days in that ruin as a toy...

steps.speaker: Scavenger
steps.content: Be careful. That blonde girl you're looking for... might have turned into a toy too.

steps.speaker: Scavenger
steps.content: Toys, toys! Three, two, one... Freeze! Hahahaha...
Flicking the DisCoins he just got from you, the old scavenger burps loudly and staggers away, mumbling something under his breath...

steps.speaker: Scavenger
steps.content: Burp... Big... Big toy? Small toy? Good toy... Bad toy! Hahaha...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You're saying that Pepper's also gotten involved in this strange toy factory?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, it's my fault for not paying enough attention. She did send me a message before she set out on an assignment.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Chief, Chief! I've found a super duper interesting place! Just right for a wicked villain like me!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Did you find new soil to plant in?

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Uh-uh! It's a factory full of evil power!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Come on, let's go together! Pepper will show you some real fun!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I was tied up with other tasks, so I turned her down. I didn't expect Pepper to go missing in the Rust for a full 24 hours after that...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I am to blame for my negligence. Fortunately, the shackles are still linked to Pepper, and I'm not too unfamiliar with the Rust anymore.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But as for this Buonanotte Factory, the information we can get is still limited. We must quickly find out more about it and send people to search for Pepper...
The night is getting darker, and the Rust's miasma of Mania has begun to interfere with communication. The red light on your device is flickering unstably.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief... Where are you... Why... the signal...
The stench of garbage mixed with the cold night air fills your lungs. You tighten your grey coat and look up as if responding to a call.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm already near the factory.
The device emits a screeching noise. The signal is now completely blocked by the invisible miasma.
You look at the dirty old map in your hands and the familiar Underground emblem on it. Considering the risk of this operation, you shouldn't drag more people into this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All this hassle just to invite a single person here. I should feel honored.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As you wish, I'm here. What will it be this time? Come on, show me.

A dried-up dead rat lies awkwardly in the middle of the path, still in a fleeing posture. The scraps of remaining flesh are covered in little holes eaten away by maggots, revealing the yellowish bones inside.
Gooey clots of old industrial fluids are spreading all the way out of the base of the building not far away.
You step over the rat, follow the source of the fluid, and stop in front of a dilapidated building.
Above your head is a wobbling door sign eaten away by rust. You can barely make out the words on it: <color=#fb9259>Buonanotte Toy Factory</color>.
You still feel a steady connection to your shackles in your palm. Pepper should be nearby. You push open the rusty door.
Creak... The screech of the opening door pierces the dead silence of the Rust at night.
The door stirs up a flow of rusty air. Behind the door, out of your sight, a notice with blurred writing falls...
Eve's home. Only Eve and her family can enter.
After midnight, it's time for Eve and her family.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pepper?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pepper——
The interior is spacious and you can hear the echoes of your own voice. The level of decay exceeds your imagination. Any small movement stirs up an astonishing amount of dust.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cough...
You cover your mouth and nose, fan away the dust in front of you, and fumble in the dark with the faint flashlight.
Finally, you find a switch-like button on the peeling wall.

The circuit emits a dull electrical noise. After a long time, the bulbs in the factory start flickering one after another. The dim lighting is barely enough to illuminate the machines in the workshop.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: According to the old scavenger, this factory should have only been abandoned for a few years.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is it because of the harsh environment of the Rust? The condition is much worse than expected.

The interior of the factory is even quieter than the Rust, making the unstable communication signal from the device somewhat jarring. You decide to turn it off completely and focus on observing your surroundings.
Dust and cobwebs are visible everywhere. The machines are of an old make, and their surfaces are mostly corroded and rusty.
You cast a cursory glance around the room. Apart from a few toys scattered on the floor, nothing seems out of the ordinary, except for the fact that nobody is here.
It's not just that there's no one in sight, there are also no signs or traces of recent human activity.
The deep, silent darkness seems to swallow your attention. You find yourself unconsciously staring into its unfocused depths, as if something is also staring back at you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pepper? Are you here?
Zzt, zzt...
What responds to you is the flickering of the unsteady light.
In the next instant, the red lights of all the instruments in the factory start blinking almost simultaneously, like well-hidden blood-red eyes, flickering on and off...
An uneasiness begins to spread.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The contamination is pungent in the air. There's definitely something wrong with this place.
Making sure that the door is still open, you make to leave the workshop and think of something else when suddenly, you hear a familiar voice next to you...
Emm... Chief...
Am I dreaming? I thought I heard Chief speaking...
It's indeed Pepper's voice! You follow the sound and begin searching, but apart from the toys strewn all over the floor, you see nothing.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Hmm, what... time is it now?
23:59:42
Bang! A gust of chilly wind blows by and the factory's door suddenly closes in your face!

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Oh no! Get out, get out! Leave this place, don't come in!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pepper? Where are you?! How come I don't see you?
Your gaze sweeps across the entire workshop. All you see are machines, toys, and more toys...
No way...
You look down for clues but suddenly feel dizzy.

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Chief! Don't worry about me! You must go now!
23:59:55
Your vision begins to spin and twist, tearing at your mind and spirit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm afraid... it's too late.

Is it taking you to another dimension? Or is this some kind of illusion... The jumbled factory ceiling is dividing your perception into pieces, making it impossible to think. Right now, all you can count on is your past experience of being caught in similar predicaments.
23:59:58

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The shackles are still connected... but... I can't muster the strength...
23:59:59

steps.speaker: Pepper
steps.content: Chief!!!
00:00:00
This is... Buonanotte, right?
This place used to be so severely contaminated. Who'd have guessed it can produce such amazing toys?
Please, please, Molewagon... Just take me in for a peek! Just a peek.
What shall we do today...
Let's pretend to celebrate Bone's birthday, shall we?
Happy birthday to you, happy...

steps.speaker: Chelsea
steps.content: Eve, another bothersome visitor's here.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: Too bad, I've already made it clear that guests are not welcome here.

steps.speaker: Oliver
steps.content: Oliver can help Eve catch them all!

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: No need, there are more important things to do... Bone is celebrating its birthday.

steps.speaker: Eve
steps.content: It's time to play house.
